proof_requests: Photo of the console's rear panel and the model/serial sticker on the base.
A power-on video showing the PS5 home screen or boot logo.
Close-up photos of both controllers showing PlayStation branding and model numbers.
Confirmation and photo proof that the FC26 disc is included in the sale.
